name: Sparse Voxel Octree Neighbor Construction
definition: An algorithm to compute adjacency relationships (neighbors) for nodes in a Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) on the GPU, enabling efficient traversal and meshing by linking sibling and cousin nodes.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Neighbor Construction is a GPU-based method that computes node adjacency using parallel CUDA kernels and Morton code lookup tables, avoiding expensive geometric intersection tests.
